name: translate
description: Provides translation of the input content from the source language to the target language.

subcommands.name: create-parallel-data
subcommands.description: Creates a parallel data resource in Amazon Translate by importing an input file from Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: delete-parallel-data
subcommands.description: Deletes a parallel data resource in Amazon Translate.

subcommands.name: delete-terminology
subcommands.description: A synchronous action that deletes a custom terminology.

subcommands.name: describe-text-translation-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with an asynchronous batch translation job including name, ID, status, source and target languages, input/output S3 buckets, and so on.

subcommands.name: get-parallel-data
subcommands.description: Provides information about a parallel data resource.

subcommands.name: import-terminology
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a custom terminology, depending on whether one already exists for the given terminology name.

subcommands.name: list-languages
subcommands.description: Provides a list of languages (RFC-5646 codes and names) that Amazon Translate supports.

subcommands.name: list-parallel-data
subcommands.description: Provides a list of your parallel data resources in Amazon Translate.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags associated with a given Amazon Translate resource.

subcommands.name: list-terminologies
subcommands.description: Provides a list of custom terminologies associated with your account.

subcommands.name: list-text-translation-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the batch translation jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: start-text-translation-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous batch translation job.

subcommands.name: stop-text-translation-job
subcommands.description: Stops an asynchronous batch translation job that is in progress.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a specific tag with a resource.

subcommands.name: translate-document
subcommands.description: Translates the input document from the source language to the target language.

subcommands.name: translate-text
subcommands.description: Translates input text from the source language to the target language.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a specific tag associated with an Amazon Translate resource.

subcommands.name: update-parallel-data
subcommands.description: Updates a previously created parallel data resource by importing a new input file from Amazon S3.
